**The argument — TTW reference notes**

Von Tobel says to call him crazy but he is buying the South Florida takeover at Auburn. Byrum Brown amassed 4,238 combined passing and rushing yards with 42 total touchdowns last year and is, in his view, one of the best quarterbacks in the country; two of his South Florida receivers come with him. Defensive coordinator DJ Durkin remains on staff, and Von Tobel rates him among the best defensive play-callers in college football over the last three seasons. He concludes Auburn has what it needs to be a surprise SEC contender.

*Rests on:* quarterback (Byrum Brown) and the receivers who transferred with him; coordinator continuity (Durkin)

Von Tobel says he is not buying the seamless transition the market is selling.
